# Membrane TCP plugin v0.6.1 - Table of Contents

> Membrane TCP plugin

## Pages

- [Membrane TCP plugin](https://membrane-tcp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://membrane-tcp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.TCP.Sink](https://membrane-tcp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.TCP.Sink.md): Element that sends buffers received on the input pad over a TCP socket.
- [Membrane.TCP.Source](https://membrane-tcp-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.TCP.Source.md): Element that reads packets from a TCP socket and sends their payloads through the output pad.
